description:
Cast Realm Razer by paying {3}{R}{G}{W}.
When Realm Razer enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, you may activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Realm Razer trigger, exiling all lands.
When Realm Razer leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
